services.name: Kid’s Classes
services.desc: We’re thrilled to host again this summer with LaToya Hampton of Safety Side Up, CPR and Baby Sitter Training for Kids & Teens at our location.The three classes offered are Safe Sitter, CPR for Babysitters, and Safe at Home. Here is the description of the classes taken from their website: Safety Side Up offers a variety of classes that address youth safety, including the always popular Babysitter Training, as well as CPR/First Aid for Babysitters and At Home Alone safety. These classes not only provide youth with safety information to assist in accident prevention and emergency preparedness, they also equip them with general life skills they will be able to use beyond the theme and duration
